atoms.text: You can do a huge variety of things on the internet: chatting to friends, shopping, watching videos and doing research. But there are also dangers in all of these, which you need to watch out for to keep yourself safe.

instruction.text: What are some possible dangers on the internet? Select all the correct answers.
What counts as personal data? Select all the correct answers.

atoms.sound: Your personal data should always be protected.

atoms.b: should only be used with their permission and should also be protected.
atoms.sound: Your friends’ personal data should only be used with their permission and should also be protected.

atoms.b: can be published thoughtlessly on the internet.

instruction.text: How should you handle other people’s data? Select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Joanna posted a picture with her friends online. Is that okay?
b: ++Only if she had asked her friends for their permission first.
Of course. She can upload anything she wants.

atoms.a: Ahmed saved all his friends’ phone numbers on a public website. Is that a good idea?
b: Yes, so everyone can communicate with each other easily.
Yes, because it is safer than saving them on his phone.
++No, because everyone on the internet can see the list, and the numbers are not protected.
